policy: Use official general defaults for every dataset; no validation/test configuration selection.

model_flags.source: code/nodeformer.py:NodeFormer.__init__ default arguments, also enabled by graph-present recipes in code/run.sh
model_flags.clarification: parse.py action=store_true booleans are CLI opt-ins, whereas these are the official model defaults and intended graph-model recipe flags; explicitly supplied here to retain NodeFormer Gumbel mechanism.

optimizer.value: torch.optim.Adam(lr=0.01, weight_decay=0.005); other Adam defaults unchanged

stopping.value: 500 epochs; author provides no early stopping; validation accuracy strict-improvement earliest-tie best selection

structural_prior: relation_union is supplied to edge regularization with lambda=0.1. rb_order=0 is the official generic default, so additive relational bias is inactive, with its original implementation preserved. No use_graph or relation switch is searched.
scaling: All five use complete full-graph attention. Checkpointed attention and chunked exact edge-log gradient bound intermediate memory without node/edge sampling. edge_chunk=16384 is an implementation memory bound, not a statistical/model hyperparameter.
inference: Official eval disables Gumbel. Every validation forward retains official query-dependent random projection. Best checkpoint stores actual per-layer projection matrices, their generation seeds, and inference RNG; frozen saved projections reproduce the selected validation forward and final test.
